findings.title: Plate/strain evidence omits the heaviest, least-supported east-edge terminals; east mid-span has no support

evidence.reproduced: tools/plate_model.py --profile r10 on a fresh fit_check report: f1 181.1 Hz pinned D5, 70.5 g, max 100 g static deflection 1.24 mm at (46.0,45.0) (the east edge mid-span) - matches the docs.
evidence.own_calc: Same plate code at 100 g, D5 pinned: peak strain J410 1359, J420 1348, J9 1312, C431 1232, J400 1155 microstrain (none of these is in the reported strain table, which lists only U4/U1/J121/C84/U5/J1/J122); 0603 R150-R155 beside J122 1328-1417. Deflection at C431 0.973 mm vs 1.30 mm static gap to a 4 mm sled plane (0.33 mm left, no dynamic amplification), C421 0.897 mm. East column carries J122+J410+J420+J9 = 34 g of the 70.5 g (masses.json) on an 82 mm unsupported edge; mid support (4,44.3) is on the light west side. Hypothetical (own calc) support at (42,59.2) instead of (4,44.3): f1 230.4 Hz, max 0.83 mm, C431 deflection 0.09 mm.
evidence.geometry: J9 body y 40.3-55.82 and J122 body y 62.55-81.57 leave 6.73 mm between bodies at x=42; a 7 mm washer (r 3.5+0.3) does not fit there, a 5.5 mm head with insulating shoulder would.

findings.impact: Bounded and already declared unqualified (optional plate model, no release floor, quasi-static only). Gap: the reported strain table hides that the east-edge terminals and the 1210-class C431 sit at 1.2-1.36 millistrain at 100 g, above common MLCC flex-crack guidance (about 1000 microstrain, Inference, not a maker limit for these parts), and that C431 keeps only 0.33 mm to the sled at h=4 mm.
findings.concrete_fix: Add J410, J420, J9, J400, C431, C421, C411 and R150-R155 to STRAIN_PARTS and the M3_R10 text; state the east-edge asymmetry; if the owner reopens placement, consider an east mid-span support near (42,59) with C431 relocated, otherwise require first-article vibration/shock and a >=4 mm standoff with underside insulation.

findings.title: Top-hardware clearance at the (4,44.3) support is 0.008 mm to the gate and 0.31-0.42 mm to exposed 3V3/NRST/GND lands

evidence.measured: Native pad boxes, F.Cu with open F.Mask, distance from support centre (4,44.3): LED2.2 GND 3.808 mm, LED1.1 GND 3.860, J2.1 3V3 3.871, J2.3 NRST 3.918. Gate TOP_HARDWARE_RADIUS 3.8 mm (7 mm washer r 3.5 + 0.3) in tools/fit_check.py; fit_check prints 3.808 vs 3.8 minimum.
evidence.docs: docs/R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF.md says nylon/covered hardware; no REQUIREMENTS line makes nonconductive top hardware mandatory.

findings.impact: A metal M3 washer or screw head within hole tolerance bridges a bare 3V3 or NRST land to GND (bench/flight). Disclosed by wording only; the numeric gate passes by 8 micrometres.
findings.concrete_fix: Make nylon (or insulated) screws and washers at all five supports an explicit ORDERING/REQUIREMENTS line, or cover LED1/LED2/J2 lands within 4.5 mm of the support with mask/Kapton at assembly. No board change needed.

findings.title: Wire-room figure uses the bare bore while P2 requires a 0.5 mm wall allowance; margin to the 4.95 mm floor is 0.053 mm

evidence.calc: room = sqrt(R^2 - z^2) - |face - 23| - 0.3 with face x 3.40 / 42.60 (fit_check model boxes), z = 5.0: R=25.4 gives 5.003 mm (matches 5.003012); with P2 radius 24.9 it is 4.503 mm; at the DB125 wire-hole height of about 3 mm read from the maker drawing (DB125 T0-1: body 8.60, hole centred ~3 mm above seating plane, Inference from the drawing scale) it is 5.32 mm (bare) / 4.82 mm (24.9). fit_check prints wire rooms only for J1, J121, J9 (SIDE_ENTRY + J1); J400, J410, J420, J122 are covered only by check_r10 P-11.
evidence.docs: docs/REQUIREMENTS.md P2 ("wire bend ... fits the bore with 0.5 mm wall allowance") vs OQ-1 and R10_DECISIONS (room to the bore wall).

findings.impact: Documentation ambiguity about what the owner-accepted 4.95 mm means; wires can also leave vertically, so no demonstrated failure.
findings.concrete_fix: State in P2/OQ-1 that wire room is measured to the nominal Ø50.8 wall at 5 mm height and that the 0.5 mm allowance is not applied to it (or restate the floor); print all seven terminals in fit_check output.

rejected_or_closed_candidates: IMU axis map: CONFIRMED. U4 B(17.0,45.9) rot 180, pad 1 at (18.21,45.15). Matching the 14 native pad positions to the ST bottom-view figure (DS14623 Rev1 p9 Fig 5) requires rotation only (no mirror, residual 0.30 mm from figure-scale reading; a mirrored fit leaves 1.98 mm). Chip axes: +X_imu = -x_board, +Y_imu = -y_board (aft), +Z_imu = -z (out of the bottom face); frame is right-handed in physical space. Roll about the forward (+y) direction = -gyro_Y; lever arm x = 17.0-23.0 = -6.0 mm, z = -2.06 mm (model box -2.52..-1.6 centre). Pin functions agree with nets (1 MISO, 4 INT1, 5/8 supplies, 12 CS, 13 SCK, 14 MOSI). Centripetal at 1850 deg/s: 0.64 g.

Bore fit: confirmed with tools/fit_check.py --profile r10 (radius 24.9, tol 0.3, top face on axis): worst margin J3 USB-C 0.89 mm (x -0.45, 0.45 mm west overhang), DB125 bodies 2.98 mm (z 0..8.9), C84 10.8 mm tall 10.58 mm, all 23 solder tails 7.56 mm (z to -3.8), deepest bottom part L1 -4.62 mm / C431 -4.30; tail projection 2.20 mm leaves 1.80 mm to a 4 mm standoff plane. Rows independently re-run, 0 issues.

Support/keep-out geometry: five supports confirmed (3.7,86),(4,4),(4,44.3),(42,4),(42,86); nearest bottom envelope C32.2 4.536 mm vs 3.5; top keep-out discussed in R18-MEC-02. (3.7,86) 7 mm washer overhangs the west edge by about 0.1 mm (harmless).

Terminal grouping: west column x=7.4 IGN(J121 y55.85)/switch(J400 65.85)/battery(J1 75.85), east column x=38.6 GPS 15.5/radio 31.5/camera 47.5/servo 71.5; all entries outward (rotation -90 -> west, +90 -> east agree with maker wire-entry +y). Contact-to-contact gap across adjacent east terminals 5.5 mm (>3.5 pitch); west 6.5 mm. Adjacent body gaps only 0.48 mm east / 1.7 mm west (disclosed courtyard overlap of 0.02 mm). Observation, not a finding: the pack is aft but J1 is the forward-most west terminal, so battery leads pass the J121/J400 wire entries in the 5 mm west corridor; no bundle model exists (physical qualification already pending).

microSD hinge-open window: closed envelope only (J430 B(24,24.3), 15.05x15.7x2.1, bottom z -3.7, 1.9 mm above a 4 mm sled plane); Molex SD-47219-001 does not dimension the open sweep and a hinged lid cannot open against the sled, so card change needs the board unbolted from the sled. Already disclosed (handoff, M3_R10); not new.

Barometer: U5 B(10.6,49.1), port side faces the sled plane with 2.9 mm model-allocated gap (package-only 3.0); dark side of the board, so light exposure is reduced; vent path/static ports are bay-level items in DESIGN_ASSURANCE, not board-checkable. U5 height wording is carried R17-MEC-04.
Mass and plate claims reproduced: 70.497598846 g and 181.1 / 256.1 / 287.9 / 407.1 Hz, 1.24 mm max deflection; masses.json allowances look conservative (DB125 3 g/2P, 6 g/4P).
